description: This file defines a PHP class 'tuleap' that provides an API wrapper for interacting with Tuleap's REST API, including methods for authentication, fetching artifacts and trackers, and updating artifacts.

classes.name: tuleap
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a minimal API client for Tuleap REST API, supporting authentication, artifact retrieval, and updates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the tuleap object with URL, username, and password.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL session with specific options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Authenticates with the Tuleap API and retrieves a token and user ID.

methods.name: getArtifactById
methods.description: Fetches an artifact by its ID.

methods.name: getTrackerById
methods.description: Fetches a tracker by its ID.

methods.name: _getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL and returns decoded JSON.

methods.name: _putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with JSON data to the specified URL.

methods.name: addTrackerArtifactMessage
methods.description: Adds a comment message to a tracker artifact.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue (artifact) in a tracker.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON data to the specified URL.
